title: Add release artifact layout and inspection script
description: Define and implement a deterministic release staging directory and inspection command for the prebuilt artifact contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The staging layout has explicit app, public, static, forwarder, manifest, and service-template locations
Inspection fails when server.js, public assets, static chunks, manifest, or required runtime files are missing
Inspection rejects secrets, databases, logs, node_modules source trees, and development-only state when included accidentally
Inspection emits a machine-readable result and a human-readable summary

steps.details: Choose paths compatible with the current Next standalone tree and record them in a manifest schema or release script.
Add a focused test or shell harness that constructs an incomplete artifact and expects inspection to fail for the missing required path.
Add a script that copies only the approved build/runtime inputs into a temporary staging directory, preserving executable permissions and excluding mutable state.
Validate required paths, permissions, architecture/version metadata, and forbidden files; return nonzero on any violation.
Run the focused test against missing and complete fixtures and verify the red-to-green behavior.

technicalNotes: Do not edit generated `dist/` or Prisma output. Keep the script cross-platform for CI where practical and shell-safe for Ubuntu.
